fact: A MICSTI/LCA tender notice (bids due 21 July 2025) seeks consultants to evaluate implementation of the Lesotho Communications Policy 2008 and draft a Lesotho Communications Policy (2025), so no replacement had been adopted and the 2008 policy was still in force.
title: Consultancy Services for Review of the Lesotho Communications Policy 2008 and Communications Act 2012
publisher: Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation / Lesotho Communications Authority (via selibeng.com)
